patch_list: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml.
Bypasses the PairIP Google Play Licensing check so the app runs without a valid Play Store license.
Patches the procedural GLSL shader in libharwin_native.so to disable the "PRISMATICA" watermark in the video player and exported videos.
